name: CookingTime
label: Cooking time
meaning: How long the dish takes to cook, in the game's own time units.

name: CookingTemperature
label: Cooking temperature
meaning: The cooking temperature the dish needs.

name: ExhaustionBonusPerMainIngredient
label: Exhaustion bonus per main ingredient
meaning: Extra exhaustion the dish removes for each main ingredient it contains.

name: ExhaustionBonusPerOptionalIngredient
label: Exhaustion bonus per optional ingredient
meaning: Extra exhaustion the dish removes for each optional ingredient it contains.

name: MainIngredients
label: Main ingredients
meaning: The ingredients a dish must have. Edited in the Ingredients card.

name: OptionalIngredients
label: Optional ingredients
meaning: The ingredients a dish may also take. Edited in the Ingredients card.
